name: amr-agent-kit
description: Public preview Codex plugin for AMR Agent Kit. Provides Redis application and AI coding patterns plus Azure Managed Redis infrastructure guidance.

interface.shortDescription: Redis code and Azure Managed Redis infrastructure skills.
interface.longDescription: The AMR Agent Kit bundles two curated agent skills for Redis and Azure Managed Redis. The redis-code skill covers Redis data structure selection, key design, efficient commands, caching, sessions, rate limiting, queues, Streams, RedisJSON and Redis Search, AMR-safe connection handling, TLS, Microsoft Entra authentication, resilience, vector search, RAG, semantic caching, LLM memory, and AI agent state. The azure-redis-infra skill covers Azure Managed Redis provisioning, SKU and tier selection, private networking, high availability, geo-replication, persistence, cluster policy, and Azure Monitor observability. Use it to help agents generate, review, and harden Redis applications and Azure Managed Redis deployments.
defaultPrompt: Review my Redis usage for Azure Managed Redis best practices.
Help me choose Redis data structures and key names for this feature.
Design a Redis vector search index for my RAG pipeline.
Add semantic caching or LLM memory with Redis on Azure Managed Redis.
Plan a secure Azure Managed Redis deployment with Private Link, Entra ID, and monitoring.
